notes.author: ted
notes.text: Larry and Deb have greeted at the front doors almost every Sunday for years. Larry remembers a guest's name the second time they come. A thank-you lunch is overdue.

replies.author: alisha
replies.text: Booked them both for the volunteer appreciation lunch.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Deb called to say she and Larry will be away next Sunday and asked for someone to cover the front doors. Let the guest services lead know.
